Monday Night Football was briefly plunged into darkness during a Monday, November 23, game between the Washington Commanders and the Cincinnati Bengals.

“Somebody turned out the lights,” ESPN broadcaster Joe Buck confirmed to Monday Night Football viewers seconds after the power shut off in Northwest Stadium during the telecast.

The Commanders were lining up for a passing attempt in the third quarter on Monday when most of the lights in the Landover, Maryland, venue suddenly turned off.

“The lights are out and we’re not home,” Buck joked. “They do it a lot around the National Football League where they turn the lights on and off.”

Why Joe Buck Had a Black Eye While Broadcasting Seahawks-49ers Game 

He then humorously guessed, “Somebody leaned against the wall!”

“We’ll see how long this takes to get them up and running,” Buck’s cohost Troy Aikman chimed in.

Buck initially offered a grim timeline for when the power might come back on, recalling that it “took forever” to resolve technical faults “back in the day.”

The situation was made all the more nerve-wracking because NFL Commissioner Roger Goodell was watching the Monday Night Football game from one of Northwest Stadium’s luxury suites.

“We’re being told it’s power-related and not the stadium,” Buck informed viewers as cameras panned around the dimly-lit stadium.

After Monday Night Football cut to a commercial break, there was good news for viewers and both NFL teams as the lights came back on.

items.title: 'St. Denis Medical' EP Addresses Ariana Madix Exit After Shocking Show Split
items.summary:
The newest episode of St. Denis Medical took a shocking turn with a surprise onscreen split — but does that mean Ariana Madix has officially left the show?

During the Monday, November 23, episode of the NBC series, Brooke (Madix) accepted a new job, marking the end of her romance with Bruce ( Josh Lawson ). Us subsequently asked creator Eric Ledgin whether the story line had reached its natural conclusion — or if it was a result of Madix’s busy schedule.

“I think both can be true. [Bruce] was certainly too much for [Brooke]. Too much or not enough, I’m not sure. Maybe both of those are true as well,” Ledgin exclusively told Us . “But I think we’re just trying to make the most entertaining, funny and logical choices for the characters in the stories we’re telling.”

Ledgin knew Bruce’s personal life had to take a turn, adding, “For me, Bruce had to be crushed, and it just had to happen. It reverberates throughout the season for him. Bruce has a lot of growing to do. I think as a person, often the way that growth happens is from being hurt and so it just made a lot of sense for the character.”

He continued, “And Ariana is so lovely and funny and we would love to have her back. It’s certainly not off the table for the character to make an appearance again.”

According to court documents obtained by People on Monday, November 23,  Alba, 45, will pay Warren, 47, $577,481 under a profit-sharing plan involving her company, HonorBar Inc.

Warren can choose to receive the payment in full immediately, an individual retirement account or another retirement plan.

Court documents state Alba will not be required to pay the Pair of Thieves cofounder any additional benefits related to her company beyond the explicitly stated amount, which will be adjusted to reflect any investment gains or losses through the date of payment.

Look Back at Jessica Alba and Cash Warren's Complete Relationship Timeline 

Us has reached out to Alba and Warren’s attorneys for additional comment.

The exes — who share Honor, 18, Haven, 15, and Hayes, 8 — split in January 2025 after 16 years of marriage. At the time, Alba said it was time for a “new chapter.”

“I’ve been on a journey of self-realization and transformation for years — both as an individual and in partnership with Cash,” Alba wrote via Instagram at the time. “I’m proud of how we’ve grown in our marriage over the last 20 years, and it’s now time for us to embark on a new chapter of growth and evolution as individuals.”

The Honest Company founder added, “We are moving forward with love, kindness and respect for each other and will forever be family. Our children remain our highest priority, and we request privacy at this time.”

items.summary:

The Olympian, who came out of a six-year retirement to compete in February 2026, was airlifted off a downhill course in Italy and flown home for a cascade of surgeries.

Scroll below for everything Vonn has said about her recovery:

A Timeline of Lindsey Vonn's Olympic Injury and Near-Amputation 

What Happened at the 2026 Winter Olympics? 
 Vonn crashed roughly 13 seconds into her women’s downhill run on February 8, 2026, suffering a complex fracture of her left tibia. She had entered the race already injured, having torn her ACL nine days earlier during a World Cup race in Switzerland.

Vonn later wrote via Instagram that she was “simply 5 inches too tight on my line when my right arm hooked inside of the gate,” adding that her ACL and past injuries “had nothing to do with [her] crash whatsoever.”

She was airlifted off the course and taken to Ca’ Foncello hospital for her initial orthopedic operation.

A Fasciotomy Saved Lindsey Vonn’s Leg 
 Vonn underwent four surgeries in Italy before being flown back to the United States on February 17, 2026, for several more operations. Days after returning home, she posted an X-ray of her leg reinforced with plates and screws alongside the caption, “I’m bionic for real now.”

Rowan’s husband and her parents explained to authorities in a second call to police that Rowan had claimed her daughter had been diagnosed with leukemia in May.

items.title: Rep. Jimmy Gomez Resigns After Alleged 'Unwanted Sexual Contact' With Aide
items.summary:
Democratic Rep. Jimmy Gomez is resigning from Congress after a House Ethics Committee report determined he allegedly made “unwanted sexual advances” and “sexual contact” with a congressional aide.

“I have strong disagreements with the committee’s report and its conclusions. Among other significant deficiencies and omissions, the report does not include key portions of my testimony that are essential to a full and fair understanding of what occurred,” Gomez, 51, said in a statement to CNN on Monday, November 23. “I also have serious concerns about the process. In my interview, I answered the Committee’s questions only to see my statements selectively quoted, disparaged and disregarded throughout the final report, to which I was given no opportunity to respond.”

The California politician added, “With this in mind, I see no other alternative than to resign, effective December 1, to allow for my staff to close out important constituent casework and needs.”

Us has reached out to Gomez’s team for comment regarding the report and his resignation.

items.title: The Bachelor’s Kelley Flanagan Explains Why She Hasn’t Dated in 2 Years
items.summary:
The Bachelor alum Kelley Flanagan hit pause on her dating life two years ago — and she hasn’t looked back.

“I haven’t been on a date in almost two years, and let me take you back to what was going on in my life two years ago,” Flanagan, 34, began in a Sunday, November 22, Instagram video .

“I was dating a guy who I found out was cheating on me, and then about a month later, my dad passed away,” she recalled. “There have only been two times in my life where I felt like I was not at a good place mentally. One was after The Bachelor , and the second was after losing my dad.”

Flanagan added that the death of her father was “one of the hardest things” she has ever experienced.

Peter Weber and Kelley Flanagan's Complete Relationship Timeline 

“For months, I just felt like I was surviving,” she admitted. “Wake up, do what you need to get done, go to bed. That was my life for months, and eventually my friends started asking me, ‘Are you seeing anyone? Are you going to start dating again?’ And I just didn’t have the mental capacity to do it.”

Flanagan continued, “I didn’t want to meet new people. I didn’t want to put myself in new environments. I just wanted to stay in my own little comfort zone, and I remember thinking that my glass was already so full that even the smallest thing could make it overflow. And I just knew I needed to get myself back to a place where I just felt OK again.”

Flanagan said she considered “three things that genuinely make me happy” to break free of her rut.

“Astrology, interior design and gardening. So that’s what I started doing,” she explained.…
